//navigationFallback: The app routes on the client, so a cold load of /quotes/7 must be answered with
index.html rather than 404. The exclusions matter as much as the rule: without them a
mistyped asset path returns index.html with a 200, the browser tries to parse HTML as
JavaScript, and the failure surfaces as a syntax error far from its cause.

routes.//: Hashed filenames are content-addressed, so a year is safe and any change ships under a new name.
The entry document is the one file whose name never changes; caching it strands users on an old build.
Same reasoning as index.html — the bare route serves the same document.

//globalHeaders: connect-src names the BFF explicitly. That is the only cross-origin destination this
app is allowed to reach, so an injected script cannot exfiltrate to anywhere else — and
the BFF host is rewritten at deploy time by scripts/set-bff-url.mjs.
style-src needs 'unsafe-inline' because the Angular build inlines critical CSS into a
<style> tag; script-src does not, because every script it emits is an external file.

globalHeaders.content-security-policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://quotes-bff.happydesert-51845d93.centralindia.azurecontainerapps.io; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'

//platform: No apiRuntime block: this Static Web App has no managed functions. The token broker is a separate Container App with its own managed identity, because SWA's managed functions cannot be given one.
